newsitem.title: FRANCE: France decorates Fiji premier for Lebanon bravery.
newsitem.headline: France decorates Fiji premier for Lebanon bravery.

text.p: French President Jacques Chirac on Friday made Fiji Prime Minister Sitiveni Rabuka a Grand Officer in the Legion of Honour, France's national order, for rescuing a French officer in Lebanon in 1980.
Chirac hailed "the bravery and intelligence" of Rabuka, who retired from the Fiji army as major-general and commanded his country's contingent of peacekeepers in Lebanon in the early 1980s.

Chirac recalled Rabuka drove French Colonel Jean-Pierre de Laforge to hospital through intense artillery bombing after the Frenchman was seriously wounded. Laforge attended the ceremony at the Elysee presidential palace.
Rabuka replied he was very honoured by the award but said any soldier would have acted the same way during what he said was "a very difficult night".
